name: Ends At
overview: Find movies and TV episodes that finish before your deadline.
description: Adds an Ends by filter and optional Ends @ finishing-time badges to Jellyfin Web. TV series use the median duration of available episodes.

versions.changelog: Makes the Include TV series setting apply consistently, including to series that have a direct Jellyfin runtime.
Localizes finishing times, filter controls, remaining-progress details, and Rewatch actions from each user's Jellyfin display language.
Adds remaining-time badges, a Rewatch action, and configurable badge clock formats.
